plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and 20 stagnant steps with zero recent improvement, the search needs more exploration to escape a flat/plateau region. auto lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic given sparse 5-D data; current_to_best balances convergence with diversity. Moderate mutation (0.6) and high crossover (0.85) for recombination, elevated exploration (0.45) to reward novelty distance, and local_fraction 0.35/radius 0.15 for a light local refinement without over-exploiting a possibly misleading surrogate. Population 30 and 6 generations keep surrogate re-fits and true-evaluation batches economical within the fixed budget.

44/100 evaluations used with slight recent improvement and high surrogate CV error (0.57), so the model is only loosely reliable: favor exploration over exploitation. auto lets held-out RMSE arbitrate RBF vs quadratic on sparse 5-D data. current_to_best retains diversity while guiding toward the surrogate-best region. Slightly higher mutation/crossover improve mixing after stagnation, exploration 0.55 rewards novelty distance to avoid resampling a misleading surrogate, and modest local_fraction/radius limit costly refinement. Population 28 with 6 generations keeps surrogate refits and true-evaluation batches economical within the fixed budget.

64/100 evaluations used, low recent improvement (~0.002), stagnation 3, and high surrogate CV error (0.54): the model is unreliable, so lean toward exploration and diversity rather than local exploitation. auto lets held-out RMSE choose RBF vs quadratic on sparse 5-D data. current_to_best balances diversity with surrogate-guided pull; raising mutation and exploration rewards novelty distance to avoid resampling a misleading surrogate. Smaller local_fraction/radius reduce wasted batch refinement, and population 26 with 6 generations keeps surrogate refits and true-evaluation batches economical under the fixed budget.

Near budget end (84/100) with full stagnation (23 iters, zero recent improvement) and poor surrogate CV RMSE (~0.64) on a 5-D problem, so the surrogate is untrustworthy and local refinement is wasted. Shift to exploratory rand1 with high mutation and exploration to leverage novelty distance and escape a stalled region; keep population 24 and generations 5 to stay economical with only ~16 true evaluations remaining, and small local_fraction/radius to avoid costly exploitation of a misleading model. auto still selects RBF vs quadratic via held-out RMSE.
